title: Maria Farmer mural showing Epstein in a flying saucer on an FBI antenna

tellings.quote: Gain Maxwell's depicted as a dragon biting a child in half it's all very nasty stuff and then there's also a a an antenna going up with an FBI flag on it with a flying saucer hanging off the top of it with Epstein's face inside the window.

plain: The artist Maria Farmer is said to have painted a mural, called The Elite, showing Jeffrey Epstein's face in the window of a flying saucer hanging off an antenna that flies an FBI flag, with Ghislaine Maxwell painted as a dragon biting a child in half. The researcher Jay Anderson describes the painting to Michels: "an antenna going up with an FBI flag on it with a flying saucer hanging off the top of it with Epstein's face inside the window." For him it hints that Farmer linked Epstein to the FBI and to UFOs.
